title: Dead Rising
shortDescription: Photojournalist Frank West survives 72 hours trapped in the Willamette Parkview Mall against thousands of on-screen zombies.
historicalSignificance: Showcased seventh-generation processing power with hundreds of interactive retail weapons and chaotic crowds.

sourceReferences: Video Game History Foundation Preservation Archive
